title: sync script: staged-set bound is path-only — session edits to merge-auto-staged (non-conflicted) files land undetected
description: Reviewer kimi-k3 pass 2.3. expected (:95) lists auto-staged paths but the extra/missing gates (:141-152) compare names only. A session that backdoors an already-staged file (workflow, this script, crate source) while resolving conflicts lands it in the commit undetected. Fix: snapshot blob hashes (git ls-files -s) of the auto-staged set pre-session; require unchanged post-session, exempting only $files.
